# Matterbridge Provider

Manages Matterbridge through the WebSocket API of its frontend: settings, plugins and their config. Some changes restart Matterbridge. During a restart, HomeKit and other Matter controllers lose the devices for some time.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    matterbridge = {
      source = "jellyfrog/matterbridge"
    }
  }
}

provider "matterbridge" {
  url      = "http://192.168.1.10:8283" # or MATTERBRIDGE_URL
  password = var.matterbridge_password  # or MATTERBRIDGE_PASSWORD; leave out if the frontend has no password
}

variable "matterbridge_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `old_password` (String, Sensitive) The password before a change. The provider tries it if Matterbridge does not accept password. The default is MATTERBRIDGE_OLD_PASSWORD.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) The frontend password. The default is MATTERBRIDGE_PASSWORD. If Matterbridge has no password, the provider connects without one. Thus, you can set the password that matterbridge_settings sets.
- `restart_timeout` (Number) The number of seconds to wait for npm and for a restart of Matterbridge with its plugins. The default is 300.
- `timeout` (Number) The number of seconds to wait for each answer. The default is 30.
- `url` (String) The Matterbridge frontend, for example http://192.168.1.10:8283. Schemes: http, https, ws, wss. The default is MATTERBRIDGE_URL.
